# Home Environment Manager v0.6.0b46 - Plain ASCII hyphens in AI and user-facing text

## Punctuation normalization

Home Environment Manager now uses the ordinary ASCII hyphen `-` in place of typographic long or doubled dashes in user-facing text:

- An en dash (U+2013) becomes a hyphen.
- A doubled en dash becomes a single hyphen.
- An em dash (U+2014) becomes a hyphen.

This applies to fixed window/room announcements, the dashboard and placeholders/ranges, translated UI descriptions, all 38 language catalogs and the generators that recreate them.

## Direct AI rewrites

Both supported Home Assistant direct AI transports (Conversation and AI Task) retain strict validation of the action, room, window names, and numeric measurements. The prompt requests ASCII hyphens. Returned valid AI text is normalized after validation, so model-generated punctuation is consistent without changing facts or actions. If AI fails, the original deterministic recommendation is used, with updated plain-hyphen fixed templates.

When Announcement Hub is selected, its own downstream AI rewrite may still format punctuation independently; this change does not modify that separate integration.

## Compatibility and safety

All beta45 improvements remain present: native classless roller shutters, their per-room association, individual cover controller devices, linked window contact, independent auto-control switch, optional pre-movement notice and temperature threshold. Manual override remains persistent, and weather/sun/window/durable-ownership safety rules are unchanged.

Only the canonical `environment_manager` integration is packaged. No migration, new hardware service, equipment authorization or physical-control behavior is introduced.

## Installation

In HACS, choose Home Environment Manager - Redownload / version selection - Show beta versions - `v0.6.0b46`, then restart Home Assistant. The GitHub prerelease also includes a manual-install ZIP. Stable remains v0.5.1; earlier beta tags remain immutable.

## Validation

The publication workflow must verify full Python 3.13/3.14 regression tests, frontend Node tests, source and regenerated 38-language text without long dashes, real HA 2026.10 smoke tests, HACS/hassfest, and exact flat HACS archive extraction before the immutable beta is created.
